Independent standard-library reproduction passed 76 arithmetic/quadrature assertions. Numeric finite n is not used to prove limits.

value.rationale: The sharp rate at which circular-polygon area and semiperimeter cease to carry distinct stochastic information is a natural unknown second-order geometric-probability invariant. The explicit optimal n-dependent slope reveals a nontrivial cubic/quintic covariance and reduces asymptotic prediction-error variance by \(80/113\) relative to the established fixed-slope extrapolation. This distinguishes the two joint observables beyond known marginal CLTs; the precise improvement serves joint inference and variance-reduction calculations.
